## Result

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue and phase; use `Closes #...` only when all acceptance evidence is provided.

## Evidence

List relevant automated checks, reference comparison, screenshots/replays, or pilot observations. Separate measured results from proposed targets.

## Review
